ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 253 Section I is the MCB Honors section, with enrollment also open to James Scholars. Concurrent registration in MCB 298 A is required. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@uiuc.edu for information and approval. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 25, 2008. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7-9 PM on October 21, 2008 and December 2, 2008. Enrollment in this course is restricted to Sophmores, Juniors and Seniors. To be considered for an override as a Freshman, please contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.uiuc.edu.
